tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, table rows, modal and dropdown surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-pink
tokens.usage: Soft decorative fill — badges, chips, empty-state blocks. Not for text.

tokens.name: surface-peach
tokens.usage: Secondary action tile fill (e.g. Restock). Not for text.

tokens.name: surface-apricot
tokens.usage: Secondary action tile fill (e.g. Add expense). Not for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: helper text, timestamps, table sub-labels.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, input borders, table borders.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, active nav item, focus accents.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state for links and text-only buttons using brand color.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-filled surface (e.g. primary button label).

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: Pending-order badge text and icon. Pair with surface-peach as its background fill.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done / completed-order badge text and icon. Also used for positive quantity deltas (e.g. a restock log's "+5 kg").

tokens.name: status-done-bg
tokens.usage: Background fill for the Done status badge. Not for text.

tokens.name: status-delivered
tokens.usage: Delivered-order badge text and icon.

tokens.name: status-delivered-bg
tokens.usage: Background fill for the Delivered status badge. Not for text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons and error text/icons.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border on outline-style destructive buttons (e.g. Cancel order, Delete entry).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows inside a card or list — lighter than border, for internal separation only.

families.heading: "Poppins", "Kanit", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "Poppins", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, segmented-control inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip and pill gaps, icon-to-text gaps, grid gaps between tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, page-edge padding, spacing between related elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Spacing between major sections on a dashboard-style page (e.g. Home).

spacing.note: These four are the meaningful steps, but the mockup also uses finer, ad-hoc values between them where a tighter fit was needed: 2px (stacked lines within one row, e.g. a name above its sub-label), 6px (label-to-input gap in forms), 10px (gap between a row's internal parts, form column gaps), 12px (gap between a row's name and its value), 22px (spacing between fields on a single-purpose form screen, e.g. New order, Restock). These aren't separate named tokens — treat them as component-level judgment calls within the 4px grid, not a second scale to memorize.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text inputs, selects, textareas.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, tiles, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, single-select tile groups, the segmented nav control and its track.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular icon-only buttons (e.g. remove-item).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards resting on the page.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets.
